# Chebotarev source provenance

The 15 Lean modules in this directory are `projects/Chebotarev/CebotarevDensity.lean`
and `projects/Chebotarev/CebotarevDensity/` from
[CBirkbeck/AINTLIB](https://github.com/CBirkbeck/AINTLIB) at commit
`f8fd7bf3f0194ae5cf015f8095a7e120ba8344d6` (2026-10-12), by Chris Birkbeck and
other contributors as recorded upstream. They are distributed under the Apache
License 2.0, whose full text is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The files are unchanged and keep their upstream module names
(`CebotarevDensity.*`). The upstream source pins Lean `v4.35.0-rc4`, as this
project does, and builds with the upstream library options
`relaxedAutoImplicit = false` and `maxSynthPendingDepth = 3`.

`Erdos940.Cubic.PrimeSupply`, `Erdos940.Quartic.PrimeSelector`, and
`Erdos940.Quartic.GaussianKummerNontrivial` import `CebotarevDensity.Main`.
